extra.efficiency_editions: UNRESOLVED (skeptic check 2026-11-14). Printed: PAGE, PAGE_US and PORTF MD metric table '33.1%' - each in the same row as PR 14.7 : 1, 548 C (1,018 F), NOx <= 15 ppmvd (edition C, the edition every other MD value of this record is taken from); PORTF data-sheet page 'Efficiency 33.3%' (with 545 C, 19.5 kg/s), PORTF imperial MD row '33.3%' (with 14.4 : 1, 1,013 F), CN and BR '33.3%' (with 14.4 : 1, 545 C, NOx <= 25 ppmvd) - i.e. every printing of 33.3 % sits next to edition-B values; POSTER (2021) '33.5' with 10,762 kJ/kWh (7,606 Btu/hph). Arithmetic: 3600/10,803 = 33.32 % (supports 33.3); 10,195 Btu/kWh and 7,606 Btu/hph give 33.47 % / 33.45 % (poster rating); 33.1 % matches no printed heat rate (it would need 10,876 kJ/kWh). Against 33.3: from edition B to C Siemens changed PR, exhaust temperature, NOx and efficiency, but no heat rate in any SGT-100 row (PG 5.1: 11,945, PG 5.4: 11,613, MD: 10,803 are identical in B and C), so in edition C the 10,803 kJ/kWh may be the stale figure and 33.1 % the updated one; the energy balance (same 19.4 kg/s and 5.7 MW, exhaust +2.8 K from 1,013 F to 1,018 F) predicts about 33.2 % for edition C and cannot separate 33.1 from 33.3. Value kept at 33.3 only so that eff_pct and heat_rate_kJ_kWh stay a coherent pair (both edition-B figures); the current-page value is 33.1 %

records.notes: Current Siemens page values (edition C) except efficiency: page prints 33.1 %, inconsistent with its own 10,803 kJ/kWh; 33.3 % (PORTF data sheet and imperial table, CN, BR = 3600/10,803 = 33.32 %) kept, but UNRESOLVED: every printing of 33.3 % is an edition-B row, and the heat rate was not updated in any row between editions, so 33.1 % may be the current figure (see extra.efficiency_editions, extra.eff_pct_conflict). Power turbine speed 13,000 rpm nominal, range 6,500-13,650 rpm (the 2021 poster's 5,750-12,075 rpm is the SGT-300 MD range copied into the SGT-100 poster, not an SGT-100 rating - see extra.pt_speed_editions). Older editions: PR 14.4, 545 C, 19.5 kg/s (see extra). Package 6.9 x 2.7 x 4.9 m / 26,944 kg excl. driven equipment, inlet filter house and exhaust stack; CN/BR pages print length 6.1 m (18.5 ft). Earlier search-extract values from an older 'dtsheet' poster (32.9 %, 10,948 kJ/kWh, PR 14.9, 19.7 kg/s, 543 C) and Teal (6.1 x 2.9 x 3.6 m, 47,227 kg) could not be reopened.
